issues.description: The getter for the StockIngredient name is named inconsistently across artifacts. In the template repository the class provides getIngredientName(), and Stock.findStockIngredient() uses getIngredientName(); in the solution repository the same conceptual getter is named getName(), and Stock.findStockIngredient() calls getName(). The problem statement asks students to "add getters for all the private fields", which implies a single canonical getter name for the ingredient name. This mismatch forces students to map two different method names to the same concept (the ingredient's name) and may cause confusion when reading template code vs. the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the getter name for the ingredient name across template and solution. Either rename the template getter getIngredientName() to getName() and update Stock.findStockIngredient() to call getName(), or change the solution to use getIngredientName() consistently. Update the problem statement references if a specific getter name is required.
